take: Pittsburgh announced it has reinstated center Blake Lizotte from injured reserve. Lizotte, a third-line forward who plays 13:08 a night and kills penalties, has no goals and four assists in 11 games, and the Penguins have controlled 61 percent of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) with him on the ice at five-on-five. Pittsburgh's team share improves by about 10 percentage points when he plays. His return should take minutes back from Hendrix Lapierre, who is next in line at 11:11 a night.
